title: 엽연초생산협동조합법시행령 / queue:ADDENDUM:17810:20021226:00003:part:1/1

ADDENDUM <Presidential Decree No. 17810, December 26, 2002>
(1) (Enforcement Date) This Decree shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation.
(2) (Transitional Measures concerning Qualifications of Tobacco Cultivation Instructors) A person who, at the time this Decree enters into force, was an employee of Korea Tobacco and Ginseng Corporation under subparagraph 1 of Article 2 of the Act on the Improvement of Management Structure and Privatization of Public Enterprises and had at least two years of experience in tobacco cultivation guidance and was recognized as qualified as a tobacco cultivation instructor under former Article 8 (1) 2 shall, notwithstanding amended Article 8, be deemed qualified as a tobacco cultivation instructor.
